summary: Retained Physics runtime synthesis PR #408 hardens canonical recipe values, metatable/no-execute boundaries, WorldEntity record/origin exact schemas, and bounded persistent-state comparison, but three outer recipe layers still accept undeclared side fields: the top-level recipe, the entities collection, and each entity-recipe wrapper. A canonical-size entities table can carry arbitrary non-array side keys because the constructor checks #entities then iterates ipairs; entity-recipe wrappers are only proven plain before reading key/entity; the root is only proven plain before known-field value checks. Those ignored fields are discarded rather than retained, but accepting them weakens the exact canonical recipe/version boundary and leaves an unbounded caller-owned schema extension surface at construction.
evidence: Inspected retained synthesis PR #408 exact product head d31c100c5d3766ca14d89b046fff4cdb09086754. assertCanonicalRecipe() uses assertPlainTable() on the recipe root and entity list, then validates known root values, but it has no fixed RECIPE_KEYS preflight.

The entities collection is checked with #entities == #CANONICAL_RECIPE.entities and then traversed with ipairs(). A string/non-array side key does not affect either check and is therefore accepted and ignored.

Each entity-recipe wrapper is checked only with assertPlainTable(rawEntityRecipe, ...), then entityRecipe.key and entityRecipe.entity are consumed. There is no exact {key, entity} wrapper schema check, so undeclared wrapper fields are accepted and ignored.

The same constructor does define RECORD_KEYS and ORIGIN_KEYS and calls assertExactStringKeys() on both records and origins, demonstrating that exact schema fencing already exists at inner canonical layers but not these three outer layers.

PR #408 synthesis tests cover top-level/entity-list/entity-wrapper metatable rejection and hostile record/origin schema keys, but contain no adversaries for extra plain root fields, entity-list side keys, or extra plain entity-wrapper fields.

Repository PR/issue/code searches found retained PR #310/#408 ownership of canonical recipe value/no-execute fencing but no separate PR, issue, or exact-key constants covering the three outer-layer unknown-field surface.

metadata.recommendedNext: After trusted live ownership allows a successor, close the outer canonical-recipe shape boundary with fixed root and entity-wrapper key sets plus a dense numeric-only entities collection preflight. Reject extra string or hostile non-string side keys before construction/registry ownership, with no caller __tostring execution. Add focused adversarial tests for extra root fields, entity-list side keys, and entity-wrapper fields. Preserve the accepted canonical 20-entity recipe bytes, WorldEntity record/origin checks, private runtime state, and transition transaction architecture; do not widen reviewed #408 while it is blocked on trust.
